items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1958-11-14
items.q: I worked there with, it was three pieces, no it was four pieces. It was Pickett's brother-in-law...

ctx.x: Who worked with you between Toulouse and St. Philip, Decatur, in that joint?
I worked there with, it was three pieces, no it was four pieces. It was Pickett's brother-in-law, he don't play anymore. He was playing saxophone and clarinet.
